title: Lifting gear
goal: Name the lifting gear, give crane signals and read a load limit.

l11-01.text: Cadet! The stores truck is here. We load everything with the provision crane.
l11-01.es: ¡Cadete! Llegó el camión de víveres. Subimos todo con la grúa de provisiones.

l11-02.text: With the crane? Can I help?

l11-03.text: Yes. I'm in the crane, you're the signalman. You watch the load and give me the signals.
l11-03.es: Sí. Yo voy en la grúa, vos sos el señalero. Mirás la carga y me hacés las señales.

l11-04.text: Wait a moment, Rolando. How heavy is the first pallet?
l11-04.es: Un momento, Rolando. ¿Cuánto pesa el primer pallet?

l11-05.text: About one point five tonnes, Chief.
l11-05.es: Alrededor de una tonelada y media, Primer.

l11-06.text: Diego, read the marking on the jib. What's the SWL?
l11-06.es: Diego, leé lo que dice la pluma. ¿Cuál es la SWL?

l11-08.text: Good. One point five is fine. But the drinks pallet is two point five. We can't lift that in one go. Split it.
l11-08.es: Bien. Una y media está bien. Pero el pallet de bebidas pesa dos y media. Eso no lo podemos izar de una vez. Dividilo.

l11-09.text: No problem, Chief. Cadet, check the sling and the shackle on the hook.
l11-09.es: No hay problema, Primer. Cadete, revisá la eslinga y el grillete en el gancho.

l11-10.text: Sling on the hook, shackle pin tight. Ready.
l11-10.es: Eslinga en el gancho, perno del grillete ajustado. Listo.

l11-12.text: Hoist slowly… Stop! Lower… lower… Stop. Load on deck.
l11-12.es: Izá despacio… ¡Pará! Arriá… arriá… Pará. Carga en cubierta.

l11-13.text: Careful! My eggs are in that pallet!

l11-14.text: Relax, Mario. Cadet, now we lash it. Lashings on, turnbuckles tight.
l11-14.es: Tranquilo, Mario. Cadete, ahora lo trincamos. Trincas puestas, tensores ajustados.

l11-15.text: Lashings on, turnbuckles tight. Nothing moves.
l11-15.es: Trincas puestas, tensores ajustados. No se mueve nada.

x-crane.text: The provision crane is on the starboard side.
x-crane.es: La grúa de provisiones está a estribor.

x-jib.text: Read the marking on the jib.
x-jib.es: Leé lo que dice la pluma.

x-wire.text: Check the wire rope before you lift.
x-wire.es: Revisá el cable antes de izar.

x-hook.text: Put the sling on the hook.
x-hook.es: Poné la eslinga en el gancho.

x-shackle.es: El perno del grillete está ajustado.

x-thimble.text: There's a thimble in the eye of the wire.
x-thimble.es: Hay un guardacabo en la gaza del cable.

x-padeye.text: Shackle the block to the pad eye.

x-block.text: Lead the rope through the snatch block.
x-block.es: Pasá el cabo por la pasteca.

x-tackle.text: We lift the box with a tackle.
x-tackle.es: Izamos la caja con un aparejo.

x-lashing.text: Put two lashings on the pallet.
x-lashing.es: Poné dos trincas en el pallet.

p-cant.text: We can't lift that in one go.
p-cant.es: Eso no lo podemos izar de una vez.

c-weight.text: This pallet is one point two tonnes.

c-crane-can.text: This crane can lift two tonnes. The pallet is three tonnes.

c-signal.text: Cadet, the load is ready. Give me the signal.

c-swl-q.text: Diego, what's the SWL of the crane?

c-heavy.text: The drinks pallet is two point five tonnes. One lift, OK?

c-whatlift.text: Rolando, what are you lifting now?

c-lifting.text: I'm lifting the vegetables. One tonne.

m-swl.es: La SWL es de dos toneladas.

m-cant.text: We can't lift that in one go.
m-cant.es: Eso no lo podemos izar de una vez.

screens.title: Stores on board
screens.body: The stores truck arrives on the quay. Rolando goes up to the provision crane, and Diego gets his first job as signalman. Listen first, one piece at a time.
screens.es: Llegan los víveres. Rolando sube a la grúa y Diego hace de señalero por primera vez.

screens.title: Crane talk
list: We can't lift that in one go.
Eso no lo podemos izar de una vez.

screens.title: Crane orders: the verb comes first
paras: Signals to the crane driver are short orders: the verb first, no you, no please.
Add slowly after the verb when you need it.
screens.avoid: You hoist. · Hoisting slowly. · Slowly hoist.

screens.q: The load is too high. You want it to go down. You say…

screens.situation: The load must go up, but carefully.
screens.q: Give Rolando the signal.

screens.title: Limits: can / can't
steps: The crane can lift two tonnes.
We can't lift two point five.
paras: can + verb, with no to and no -s: it can lift.
in one go = all in one lift.
screens.avoid: It can lifts. · It can to lift. · We don't can lift.

screens.q: The SWL is 2 tonnes. The pallet is 3 tonnes. We ___ lift it in one go.
How heavy is the pallet? Write the number of tonnes.

screens.title: One POINT five, not one comma five
paras: In English the decimal mark is a point: 1.5 = one point five.
Say every digit after the point: 2.25 = two point two five.
Tonne is the metric tonne, 1,000 kg. Written t.
screens.avoid: one comma five · one and a half point

screens.q: Rolando writes 1.5 t. He says…

screens.title: Tackle on deck: TAY-kul
paras: At sea, for blocks and rope, many seafarers say TAY-kul /ˈteɪkl/. You'll hear both: they mean the same thing.
Thimble starts with the th of think: put your tongue between your teeth.

screens.q: Which one is correct?
opts: The crane can lift two tonnes.
The crane can lifts two tonnes.
The crane can to lift two tonnes.

screens.title: SWL or WLL?
paras: SWL, Safe Working Load: the most you may lift with that gear on board. You see it painted on cranes, davits and pad eyes.
WLL, Working Load Limit: the most the maker certifies for a loose part, like a shackle or a sling. It's stamped or written on its tag.
Newer rules use WLL, but on board you'll see both. With several parts together, the lowest limit is the limit of the whole set.

screens.q: What is the SWL of the provision crane?
Where is the WLL of the shackle written?
screens.why: WLL: stamped or written on the part itself.

screens.q: Tap the gear with the lowest limit.
You lift a 1.5 t pallet with the crane, sling No. 7 and the shackle. Is it OK?
screens.why: Crane 2 t, sling 2 t, shackle 4.75 t: the lowest is 2 t.

screens.q: When is the next inspection?

screens.title: Short and clear
screens.body: Listen, say it, check it. Crane signals are short and strong: HOIST slowly. LOWer. STOP!

screens.task: The load must go up, carefully. Give the signal.
Read the jib: SWL 2 t. Answer.
The SWL is 2 t. Say you can't lift it in one go.
accept: We can't lift that in one go.
We can't lift it in one go.
No, we can't lift that in one go.
We cannot lift that in one go.

screens.task: Say the lashings are on and the turnbuckles are tight.
accept: The lashings are on and the turnbuckles are tight.
